text:
Maya Cheng: Incident resolved — quick summary: between 05:14–05:38 UTC we saw elevated tail latencies (5–12s) and some 500 responses for the hosted text-generation API in us-west-2. Root cause appears to be autoscaler mis-evaluating available GPU capacity which triggered an emergency fallback to the CPU-quantized execution path; that fallback overloaded the control-plane and caused request queuing. We rolled back the autoscale policy (05:22), added temporary reserved nodes to the dedicated pool (05:25), and disabled the CPU fallback for the affected model family (05:30).

Maya Cheng: Opening this thread to coordinate the postmortem, track remediation action items, and plan customer communications. Who can own the RCA and a customer-facing summary?

SRE-Bot: Pager cleared at 05:39 UTC. Incident classified sev2. Auto-timeline: 05:10 alert spike (tail latency), 05:14 first page, 05:22 policy rollback, 05:25 capacity bump, 05:30 fallback disabled, 05:38 metrics stable again. Logs/trace bundle archived to s3://redwood-incidents/2060001111/trace-bundle.tar.gz

Luis Ortega: I'll take the RCA. Will pair with Priya on impact numbers. I need the per-route traces + node-level metrics for the 05:10–05:40 window. Starting draft timeline now. Can we do a 90-min postmortem slot tomorrow 14:00 UTC? :calendar:

Priya Patel: I can do impact analysis and compile customer list. Early numbers: approx 3% of total requests returned 5xx, ~12% experienced latency >2s during the blast window. Hit customers list coming — will put into the share doc by EOD. Also will extract traces and the slow-request sample set.

Ben Kumar: Product action: fallback gating is too aggressive. Proposal: feature-flag the CPU-fallback with a per-customer rate cap and require a slow-roll canary. I'll own the design + rollout plan. Target: design by Fri, rollout gating + telemetry by next Tue. :+1:

Alex Rivera: CS notes — we have 12 customers who opened tickets tied to the timeframe; 4 are enterprise (dedicated) customers and will need an exec-synced note. Drafting a short status-page blurb + targeted email. Prefer the external RCA to be non-technical with a link to a more detailed engineering appendix. Will share draft by noon tomorrow.

Maya Cheng: Good. Let's capture action items here so we have a single tracker.

Maya Cheng: ACTIONS:
1) Luis Ortega — Lead RCA and timeline write-up. Attach traces + root-cause analysis. Due: 48h (by 2060009931).
2) Priya Patel — Customer impact numbers, per-customer hit list, and sample traces. Due: EOD today (2060004600).
3) Ben Kumar — Implement fallback gating design + rollout plan. Due: design by 2060085311, rollout plan by 2060690111.
4) Alex Rivera — Draft external comms (status page + targeted emails) and exec note for affected enterprise customers. Due: draft by 2060005200.
5) Maya Cheng — Postmortem meeting facilitation and action-tracking board creation. Due: schedule meeting by 2060003000.

Luis Ortega: Confirming action 1. I'll start with the autoscaler decision tree and the OOM/eviction logs from the scheduler. Need the k8s eviction logs — @Priya can you attach those? Also want to capture the traffic shaping rules that triggered fallback.

Priya Patel: Attaching pointers in the doc: s3://redwood-incidents/2060001111/node-metrics.csv and scheduler-evictions.log (already uploaded). Will also add per-customer request rates and the list of customers that saw >1 error.

Support Bot: Reminder: please add any customer tickets to the incident board so we can correlate. Ticket IDs: RW-4451, RW-4453, RW-4460 referenced.

Oncall Rotation: Night handoff notes — runbook amended with the temporary mitigation steps (rollback autoscale; bump reserved pool; disable fallback). Docs link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/serving/fallback-handling. Please ensure the runbook also includes the check-list for verifying KV cache consistency after switching serving paths.

Maya Cheng: Proposed postmortem agenda: 1) timeline and impact (Luis/Priya), 2) root cause analysis (Luis + infra), 3) immediate mitigations and why they worked (oncall), 4) long-term remediation (Ben + infra), 5) customer comms plan (Alex), 6) action owners and due dates. Plan is to record and produce a 1-page exec summary for stakeholders.

Ben Kumar: Quick technical note: the fallback path uses a CPU quantized model that bypasses our streaming kernel optimizations; it has a different concurrency model (per-request threads) which saturated the CPU under high QPS. We need to add a concurrency guard and a circuit-breaker (proposal in the doc).

Luis Ortega: Quick repro log snippet:
```
[05:21:47] scheduler: pod evicted: reason=OutOfResources node=gw-3a
[05:22:03] autoscaler: policy rollback invoked -> previous policy restored
[05:24:12] serving: fallback to cpu-quantized model triggered for model-id: rwd-small-v1
[05:25:10] control-plane: queue depth spike -> 1200 pending
```

Maya Cheng: Customer comms plan: Alex to post status page entry with timeline and ack of investigation; once RCA is ready we'll share a technical appendix. For enterprise customers we'll offer 1:1 RCA calls for those who request it. Also planning a trust-restoration note offering a credits package (legal ok?) — Alex, check with sales/finance and advise on wording.

Alex Rivera: Confirmed: will coordinate with Sales + Finance. Suggest offering a service credit equivalent to 5% for impacted billing period for the enterprise customers who saw errors. I'll propose the language in the draft.

Priya Patel: One more data ask — can infra provide a list of allocations changes during the window (node additions/removals) and any autoscaler events? @Luis can you pull from cluster-audit? I'll need it for the appendix.

Luis Ortega: Yep, pulling cluster-audit now. Expect CSV in s3 in ~20m.

Maya Cheng: Scheduling: I propose postmortem tomorrow 14:00–15:30 UTC. If that works I'll book a meeting and include the draft agenda + dial-in + recording. Please react with :white_check_mark: if you can attend.

Priya Patel: :white_check_mark:
Luis Ortega: :white_check_mark:
Ben Kumar: :eyes: I'll try to make the last 30m.
Alex Rivera: :white_check_mark:

Maya Cheng: Thanks all. I'll create the incident board (link will be posted) and tag the actions. Please keep this thread updated if you find anything else. After the postmortem we'll produce the public-facing RCA and a timeline for the remediation items.

SRE-Bot: Incident board created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2060001111. Action tracking card IDs: INC-2060001111-1..5. Recorder enabled for postmortem meeting.
